citations.claim: cart exceeds track at first violating step
cart already near end and moving outward shortly before violation
steady drift outward from initial offset with growing negative velocity
pole remains upright so controller prioritizes balance over cart recovery

counterfactual.change: Zeroed initial cart offset and velocity (x=0, v=0) keeping pole state and plant identical; cart no longer drifts off track, so failure is caused by uncorrected initial cart drift, not pole instability.

explanation: Controller balances pole (theta stays ~-0.06 to -0.08, margin ~0.72) with only ~0.3-0.8 force, far below 50.4 limit, but applies insufficient cart-position correction to overcome initial x=-0.45, v=-0.287 drift. Velocity grows more negative (-0.64 at step 100, -0.95 at 150, -1.29 at 190) despite positive force, so cart coasts off the -2.4 end at step 198.

violation.detail: cart at x=-2.416 outside the +/-2.4 track

vision_note: The cart slides steadily leftward across steps 195 to 198 while the pole stays nearly upright on top of it. By step 198 the cart reaches the far left end of the track, leaving the allowed region even though the pole never falls.
